offlineDraft.deviceDraftText: Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea were present during the visit. Mould was observed in the back bedroom, particularly near the window, and its condition appeared worse. Landlord did not respond to two emails. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the benefits form deadline last week, and the form is present on the table; the date of birth on the form is 3/3/87.  It was agreed that a call would be made to Landlord on Monday, and Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form by Friday. Tomas Brandvold has offered to assist Maria Okonkwo-Reyes with completing the form. A risk of rent arrears exists if the form is submitted late. The next step is to revisit 26/11.
